title: Events & Field Marketing Manager - India
jobDescription: About Us Temporal is an open source programming model that can simplify code, make applications more reliable, and help developers focus on the important things like delivering features faster. We are on a mission to be the reliable foundation of every developer’s toolbox, and are building the team that will make that happen.   Our values guide us —they are present in how we show up, make decisions, and work together to make an impact. We’re curious, driven, collaborative, genuine and humble.   Temporal is growing and we are looking for those who share our values, challenge 'standard' thinking, and want to influence our future. If you have a passion for improving the developer experience, building world-class open-source software and communities, and want to be a part of our amazing team, we'd love to hear from you! Summary Temporal’s Global Events & Field Marketing team is seeking an experienced Events & Field Marketing Manager to lead and grow our regional marketing efforts across India. In this highly cross-functional role, you will develop and execute integrated marketing programs that increase brand awareness, generate pipeline, and deepen engagement with customers, prospects, and the developer community. A core responsibility of this role is driving the strategy, planning, execution, and operational management of Replay, Temporal’s flagship developer conference series, as we expand its presence into India. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll play a critical role in expanding Temporal’s field marketing presence across India while scaling Replay into a premier developer conference that showcases innovation, strengthens our community, and accelerates business growth. Working closely with Sales, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Global Marketing, you will deliver exceptional event experiences and integrated campaigns that drive measurable business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized, proactive marketer who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’re comfortable operating independently, taking ownership from strategy through execution, and partnering across teams to deliver impactful programs that move the business forward. What You’ll Do Own Regional Strategy & Planning : Contribute to the annual and quarterly events calendar and budget for the APJ region, aligning with global priorities and local market needs. Lead Replay India: Own the strategy, planning, execution, and operational management of Replay in India, delivering a world-class developer conference that drives community engagement, showcases innovation, and supports pipeline and brand growth. Execute Regional Campaigns : Design and deliver integrated marketing programs tailored to regional goals, including account-based marketing, digital campaigns, workshops, meetups, and partner activations. Lead Event Execution : Manage end-to-end planning and execution of trade shows, conferences, developer summits, and sponsorships; including logistics, vendor management, equipment, catering, travel, collateral, and swag. Drive Community Engagement : Partner with Developer Relations to support grassroots programs, meetups, and champion networks that foster adoption and strengthen Temporal’s developer community. Adapt Global Programs Locally : Localize global marketing initiatives to ensure cultural, language, and compliance alignment within the APJ region. Collaborate Cross-Functionally : Partner with Sales to drive pipeline creation and acceleration, and with Marketing teams to plan pre-, during-, and post-event engagement programs. Measure & Optimize : Track performance, budgets, and ROI of all regional programs, delivering actionable insights to stakeholders. What You’ll Bring: 5+ years of field marketing or demand generation experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure, or cloud industries. Proven success executing regional marketing programs that drive awareness, adoption, and pipeline growth. Strong experience managing events of all sizes – from grassroots meetups to large-scale conferences. Hands-on expertise with event sponsorships, including contract negotiation, vendor management, and deliverables. Familiarity with India & APJ market dynamics, cultural nuances, and compliance requirements. Demonstrated ability to thrive under pressure and manage multiple projects against tight deadlines. Strong collaboration skills and experience partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, and Developer Relations teams. Experience using marketing technologies such as Salesforce and Marketo (preferred, not required) Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills. Passion for open source, developer communities, and distributed systems. Compensation The estimated pay range for this role is ₹4,080,000 - ₹5,100,000. Compensation ranges reflect salary and commission compensation (when applicable) across several geographic markets. Employment offers carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, knowledge, expertise, skillset, market location, and job level assessed during the interview process.   Employee benefits and perks below are for full-time employees, part-time or temporary positions are excluded.    U.S. Benefits  Unlimited PTO, 12 Holidays + 2 Floating Holidays 100% Premiums Coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision AD&D, LT & ST Disability, and Life Insurance (Standard & Supplemental Available) Empower 401K Plan Additional Perks for Learning & Development, Lifestyle Spending, Home Office Setup, Professional Memberships, WFH Meals, Internet Stipend and more! International Benefits Paid Time Off (PTO) and Benefits outside the United States vary by country, and are issued in partnership with Remote.com .  Additionally, Temporal offers perks to all international employees for learning & career development, a lifestyle spending account, home office setup, professional memberships, work-from-home meals, and access to the Calm app for mental wellness. Travel Temporal is a globally distributed, collaborative team that values opportunities for in-person connection. Occasional travel may be required for company events, team offsites, and other meaningful moments that bring us together.   Temporal Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
